ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram shown, which organism uses thyme as a direct food source?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, containing labels such as Jackal, Black Mamba, Emperor Scorpion, Beetle, Jerboa, Desert Grass, Thyme and Camel. Thyme is located at the lower right of the diagram, and Camel is located at the upper right of the diagram. In the diagram, an arrow starting near Thyme points upward to Camel. Reasoning: The question asks which organism directly feeds on thyme. In a food web, arrows point from the food to the eater; since it points directly from Thyme to Camel, the one that directly uses thyme as a food source is camel.
